dataset.name: CREMA-D
dataset.license: ODbL-1.0 (database); DbCL-1.0 (individual contents); full text in CREMA-D-LICENSE.txt
clips_missing: 1040_ITH_SAD_X.wav (train split; not retrievable from the mirror)

splits.note: The same actor-disjoint split as the Audial emotion models.

code: browser/sanket/engine.js (FrameAnalyser, 32 ms frames / 16 ms hop at 16 kHz)
features.note: Training extracted features with the same JavaScript that runs in the browser (training/sanket/extract_crema.mjs).

training.personal_head: MLP (64,), alpha 0.1, on features z-scored against a mostly calm usual-voice baseline, temperature-calibrated

evaluation: models/sanket/evaluation.json; tests/sanket.test.js re-checks browser inference against the training report on every run
credits: Speaker splits and evaluation approach from Audial AI (Vedant Sood, MIT). Built for Hackcessible India 2026.
